quest.title: And This Treasure Goes To...
quest.description: You discovered a strange encampment in Lingju Pass. Something seems to have happened here...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This diary seems to belong to a scholar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems that some Treasure Hoarders had their eyes on her... Paimon hopes she was able to leave safely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe the scholar who camped out here really did get into trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's look around. We might find some clues!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Besides, this scholar was researching this place for so long. She probably knows this place super well!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If there was treasure in here, she might have...

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "...Still no clues at all. I knew I shouldn't have chosen Liyue as the subject of my research. At this rate, I'll have to return empty-handed..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "...If I do return empty handed, that old geezer is going to nag at me till I go insane... Come to think of it, Soraya is also doing research in Liyue, and she's staying at the Wangshu Inn. If she could help me out a bit..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "Ugh, Soraya hasn't responded to my letters. Perhaps it was a bit rude of me to suddenly write her? We only took the same class, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "She probably doesn't remember me anymore... Well, I'll stay a few days more. If there's still nothing, then I'll have to go back..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "Soraya's research methods are truly brilliant! To think that you could approach things from this angle. If I had only consulted her earlier, I wouldn't have had to waste so much time..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "But she did warn me to be a slightly more careful, to not camp out in the wild, and to keep my notes close with me, lest I attract the attention of the Treasure Hoarders..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "It can't be. Could those Treasure Hoarders really be so audacious? Well, it doesn't matter. I'll leave in a few days, anyway..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "Maybe I'm just getting paranoid, but I feel like I see silhouettes on the <color=#00E1FFFF>mountain to the west</color>... someone's also been inside my camp, flipping through my notes..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Diary
dialogues.text: "Soraya was right. I have to leave this place..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. This bonfire's been put out for a long time. The person who camped here seems to be gone, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes... It looks like there was a big fight here. Everything's a mess!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Someone's carved words here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "They're taking me up the mountain. Save me."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be our scholar. Come on, let's get up that mountain!

talks.objective: Defeat the Treasure Hoarders and obtain the key

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. I thought I was truly finished... that group of Treasure Hoarders had been following me this entire time.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Just as I had finally made some progress in my research, and was thinking that it might be nice to find the treasure here and take it back with me...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: The Treasure Hoarders invaded my camp, nabbed me, and brought me here.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: They kept questioning me as to the treasure's location, and threatened to take my life if I refused to tell them.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: But if I had told them just like that, that really would have been the end of me.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: *sigh* I should've listened to Soraya. She always insists that archaeologists like us should be focused on academic results instead of treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: But I only get this much funding. A few essays won't be enough to break even on my travel expenses...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I can't for the life of me say how Soraya's managed to stay in Liyue by herself for all this time. Just looking at her pile of rejected manuscripts makes me feel exhausted.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you plan to do now?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Well, what else? I've finished gathering my research material. As for the treasure... Well, you can have it.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I'm not repeating the convoluted thought process that brought me here. All you need to know is that the treasure is buried <color=#00E1FFFF>underneath that giant golden tree</color> in the middle of Lingju Pass.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Take it if you want. I'll write its description down for you so you don't forget.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I'll rest for a while, and then I'll head back to my camp to gather up my things. I have to get out of here as soon as possible, lest more Treasure Hoarders come here.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I've no idea how long it'll take to get from here to Wangshu Inn. I can only hope that Soraya hasn't already left by the time I get there.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only Soraya could be my tutor...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: My notes... thank goodness, my notes are still intact.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Huh? You haven't found it yet? The treasure is buried beneath the <color=#00E1FFFF>giant golden tree</color> in the middle of Lingju Pass.
